purpose: Educational scenario assumptions; not calibrated operational estimates
monetary_unit: source monetary units; source currency is unspecified
demand_horizon: Replay of mapped orders in the 2021-2024 sample; not a future forecast
limitations: Every numeric logistics and dispatch parameter is an explicit hypothetical assumption
Distance-dependent dispatch coordination is an assumed planning buffer before shipment, not vehicle transit time
The planning distance multiplier is a cost/planning proxy, not a measured road-route factor
Equal default factory costs and preparation times are neutral assumptions, not evidence of equivalent capability
Capacity and compatibility remain unknown; candidates are not approved or feasible assignments
Sensitivity ranges are assumption bounds, not statistical confidence intervals
No offset is applied to source shipment dates and no diagnostic regression model is used for operational estimates
